धूर् (य, ङ, ई) धूर्य्यते 4.
d. To kill or
hurt; to move or approach.

धुर-न्धर (रः) 1.
m. A beast of bur-
then; bearing a burden.

धुरा (रा) 1.
f. A burden, load.
adv. Before.

धुरोण (णः-णा-णं)
a. Bearing a bur-
den, burdened, loaded.
m. Man
of business; beast of burden.

धुरीय (यः-या-यं)
a. Fit to bear;
loaded.
m. Man of business.

धुर्य्य (र्य्यः) 1.
m. Idem.

धुर्व्व (इ) धुर्ब्बति 1.
a. To kill or hurt.

धु-र्व्वह (हः-हा-हं)
a. Bearing a bur-
den, loaded.
m. A man of busi-
ness; beast of burthen.

धू-र्व्वह (हः-हा-हं)
a. Bearing, sus-
taining, managing.

धूर्गत (तः) 1.
m. A driver.

धूर्ज्जटि (टिः) 2.
m. A name of
Shiva.

धूर्त्त (र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
a. Fraudulent; mis-
chievous.
m. A gamester, a
rogue; a thorn-apple.
n. Rust,
iron filings; black salt.

धूर्त्तक (कः) 1.
m. A jackal.

धूर्त्त-कितव (वः) 1.
m. A gamester.

धूर्त्त-कृत् (त्) 5.
m. A rogue, a cheat,
a knave; a thorn-apple.

धूर्त्त-जन्तु (न्तुः) 2.
m. Man.

धूर्त्त-ता (ता) 1.
f. Craftiness, knavery.

धूर्त्त-मण्डल (लः) 1.
m. A party or as-
OK^1 of rogues or gamblers.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar, jim funderburk on 20210816. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/73.

धूर्त्त-मानुषा (षा) 1.
f. A mimosa plant.

धू-र्धर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Bearing, manag-
ing.
m. A beast of burthen.

धूर्व्वी (र्व्वी) 3.
f. The fore part or
pole of a carriage.
